title.narrative: Cote d'Ivoire Private Investment and Productive Jobs DPF1

description.narrative: Scale-up private investment for more productive jobs by: (i) unlocking critical sectors for structural transformation, and (ii) strengthening the business climate and workforce readiness

The development objective of the First Private Investment for Productive Jobs Development Policy Financing for Côte d’Ivoire is to scale-up private investment for more productive jobs by: (i) unlocking critical sectors for structural transformation, and (ii) strengthening the business climate and workforce readiness. Pillar 1 focuses on reforms aimed at mobilizing additional investments in key sectors to scale up productive job creation, including energy, digital, and water to improve equitable access to quality infrastructures with the support of private actors; boost agricultural innovation and formalization to unlock the potential of agribusiness value chains; and crowd in private capital to improve health service delivery. Pillar 2 addresses the cross-cutting constraints that inhibit private investment and workforce readiness, by boosting land tenure security, overhauling an outdated investment promotion framework, making tax systems better able to support both revenue mobilization efforts and competitiveness, and addressing mismatches between the demand and supply of skills on the labor market.
